Steps:

3. Run: python3.11 /home/ubuntu/lihtc_data/find_comps_v2.py
4. Run: python3.11 /home/ubuntu/lihtc_data/build_excel.py
5. Send the file /home/ubuntu/lihtc_data/ApartmentCorp_Rent_Comp_Analysis_2026_REVISED.xlsx via Gmail MCP (gmail_send_messages, server: gmail) to BOTH Brandon@apartmentcorp.com AND Mam@22.bz with subject "Rent Comparables for all ApartmentCorp Properties — [today's date formatted as Month DD, YYYY]" and body: "Good morning,

Please find attached the daily Rent Comparables Analysis for all ApartmentCorp properties, refreshed as of [today's date].

FY2026 HUD Fair Market Rents are included as market benchmarks for each city.

Best regards,
ApartmentCorp Analytics
Brandon@ApartmentCorp.com"
